Requirements Your souls are harmonized.

When you are working in tandem with your paired soul, the anima flows freely. You can Strike and Cast a 1-action or 2-action Anima spell, in either order. Both actions must target the same single creature. If the outcome of your first action is a hit or a failed saving throw, the target is off-guard and takes a -2 circumstance penalty to their saving throw to the second action.
